label: Diagram 3.17
caption: Diagram 3.17 Examples of wheelchair accessible bathrooms with both bath and shower
description: This drawing, Diagram 3.17, contains two floor plans of bathrooms, each showing a dashed wheelchair turning circle, a glass shower screen and a door arc. The upper plan, Example 3.17A, is captioned as a wheelchair accessible bathroom with bath and 1000 x 1200mm shower with capacity for a larger shower if the bath is removed. Its top edge is dimensioned 3100mm, split into 1000mm, 800mm, 450mm and 150mm; the left edge 2200mm with internal 1700mm and 1200mm; the right edge 750mm. It shows a bath at left, a water closet at top right and a basin at right, with a leadered note reading 1000 x 1000 x 100mm zone kept clear to enable fitting of rails. The lower plan, Example 3.17B, is captioned as a wheelchair accessible bathroom with bath and 1200 x 1200mm shower; its top edge is 2900mm split into 700mm, 1000mm and 1200mm; left edge 2600mm with 1700mm and 800mm; right edge 150mm, 1200mm, 800mm and 450mm. It shows a bath top left, basin bottom left, water closet bottom right, and the same rail-zone note. Numbered notes to the right concern dimensions, doors and stack and drainage positions.
